page.layout: One printed page: running head at top centre with page number at top right; main text in one column, with marginal notes (section numbers 4 and 5) in the right margin; a catchword-like signature mark "l" and the word "Cuiuf-" at the foot.

main_text.p: Quod enim perpetuum æternumq; est, id prius excellentiusq; existit illo quod est in tempore: Atqui solus motus localis est perpetuus, quod in motu cœli animaduerti potest. Igitur tempore quoq; prior est aliis motibus.

Quarta: Motus localis est prior perfectione. Motus localis cernitur in iis quæ secundum naturam maximè sunt perfecta, ut in omnibus animatis quæ sese loco mouent, atq; omnium consensu perfectiora sunt inanimatis. Ergo motus localis reliquis motibus præeminet & perfectior censebitur.4.

Quinta: Confirmatur idem: Ille est perfectior motus, per quem de rerum mobilium natura substantiaq; quàm minimum decedit. Huiusmodi autem est motus localis. Igitur motus localis est perfectior. Minor probatur: Per alias species motus aliquid decedit mobilibus in sua substantia. Nam in alteratione res transmutatur secundum qualitatè, ut calida fiat, quæ ante fuerat frigida: & dura, quæ ante sfuerat mollis. In augmento autem vel decremento fit transmutatio quædam secundum quantitatem, & utrobiq; in substantia subiecti mobilis. Verùm in motu locali nihil decedit de substatia subiecti: manet nàq; prorsus eadem res, quæ antea fuerat, tantùmq; fit mutatio quædam exterius secundum locum. Ergo abundè probatum est, primùm motum esse motum localem, non autè motum secundum qualitatè aut quantitatem.5.

page.notes: The right margin notes "4." and "5." are section numbers beside the paragraphs "Quarta" and "Quinta". The foot mark "l" is a gathering signature. Some long-s and ligature forms were normalised to plain s and ligatures as printed. Possible doubtful readings: "sfuerat" (printed with a stray mark between s and fuerat, rendered as printed), "substatia" as printed. The running head is in capitals and the page number 161 is printed at top right, in the printer's old-style numerals (rendered as 161).
